name: Zulkaif Seo File Manager
author: Zulkaif Riaz

sections.description:
Zulkaif Seo File Manager is a lightweight WordPress SEO utility plugin that gives site owners full control over essential SEO files. Unlike other SEO plugins, Zulkaif Seo File Manager focuses on manual management, transparency, and user control, without silently overriding existing files or settings.

Key Features:
* Manual Sitemap Generation – Create XML sitemaps with full control over included content.
* Robots.txt Management – Safely edit and preview rules.
* Ads.txt Editor – Manage advertising declarations with entry-based or raw editing.
* Conflict Detection – Alerts for potential conflicts with other SEO plugins.
* No Silent Automation – All actions require explicit user approval.
* WordPress Native – Built with WordPress APIs and coding standards.

Detailed Features:

Sitemaps:
* Choose content types to include (posts, pages, media, categories, tags)
* Manual generation, controlled by the user
* Automatically excludes noindex content
* Preview before going live
* Compatible with WordPress core sitemaps

Robots.txt:
* Add custom rules safely without overriding WordPress core
* Live preview of effective robots.txt
* Automatic sitemap reference inclusion
* Detects existing physical robots.txt files
* Supports multiple sitemap sources

Ads.txt:
* Entry-based management with validation
* Raw text editor for advanced users
* Creates physical file via WP Filesystem API
* Virtual fallback if directory not writable
* Prevents incorrect entries with clear warnings

Advanced Settings:
* Control cache duration
* Prefer physical file creation
* Toggle conflict detection
* Debug mode for troubleshooting
* View system information

sections.installation:
1. Upload the zulkaif-seo-file-manager folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Navigate to Zulkaif SEO in your WordPress admin menu
  4. Configure your settings and generate your sitemap
sections.faq:
Does Zulkaif Seo File Manager automatically update my sitemap?

No. Zulkaif Seo File Manager is fully manual. You control when sitemaps are generated or updated.

Can I use this alongside other SEO plugins?

Yes. Zulkaif Seo File Manager detects potential conflicts and alerts you. It is designed to respect existing files.

What if my robots.txt or ads.txt directory is not writable?

The plugin provides a virtual fallback so your rules still apply even if physical file creation fails.
